name: Kanbara Satomi
source: Satomi is a third-year at Tsuruga Academy and the president of the school's Mahjong Club. She is very laid-back type of person but one who, at times, can be very insightful. She is the type of person who is brimming with confidence and nothing seems to get at her. She has great trust in Yumi Kajiki as well as the other members of her club. At first, Yumi thought she was an idiot with an empty-headed grin, but changed her opinion after they became friends. Kanbara's most distinguishing feature is the fact that she almost never stops smiling and her distinctive laughter style, I.E. "Wahahaha!". She is one of the few who can detect Momo, though only when she is upwind of her.
